summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi IONQ 2x Daily ETF (IONC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of IonQ, Inc. (IONQ) which operates as a technology leader that develops and commercializes trapped-ion quantum computing hardware, networking, and software. IONC was launched on Jun 30, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
